runs.does: DCP load: every rank reads .metadata, then the items of its shard file (fan-in `replicas`).

runs.does: np.load of one ~140 MiB .npz per sample through a PyTorch DataLoader; magic, zip tail, then the archive front to back.
runs.is: The Unet3D job, every accelerator's (item 39, DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.81): .npz samples sized as the WG's reference workload sizes them (its DLIO configs unet3d_*.yaml, record_length_bytes 146,600,628 and record_length_bytes_stdev 68,341,808; provisional, 2026-10-23, until the preprocessed KiTS19 corpus is measured), 4 DataLoader workers per GPU (read_threads) each 2 batches ahead, 500 steps. `samples` is the submission's to size. Unet3D on an A100: batch 7 and 636 ms of compute per step, the WG's reference values (its DLIO config unet3d_a100.yaml: batch_size, computation_time).

runs.does: One engine per actor; `concurrency` request slots; each request continues an earlier conversation or starts one.
runs.is: Fitted by agentx.py to traces.jsonl (393 sessions): 98827 requests in 10079 chains; 3.9% of continuing requests cut their chain (trim) and the chain grows by 107% of the corpus's prompt growth (the reply counted whole where the model kept less of it); sys_tokens the main agent's prefix (the prefix its cuts most often keep), sub_tokens the median prefix a sub-agent's first prompt shares with its session, kind the chains' first prompts by the prefix they open with; keep not measured (the proxy saw no engine). decode_per_token, keep, prefill_per_token, prefill_step, and sys_pop: the values the abstract's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78), not fitted.

runs.does: One engine per actor; `concurrency` request slots; each request continues an earlier conversation or starts one.
runs.is: Fitted by agentx.py to traces.jsonl (8 sessions): 223 requests in 45 chains; 1.1% of continuing requests cut their chain (trim) and the chain grows by 101% of the corpus's prompt growth (the reply counted whole where the model kept less of it); sys_tokens the median prefix a sub-agent's first prompt shares with its session; the requests replay_agentx.py sent (8 sessions as 8 slots, 28 requests each, back to back), and keep from the server's log: of 178 continuing requests the engine held the whole kept prefix in 6. decode_per_token, prefill_per_token, and sys_pop: the values the abstract's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78), not fitted.

runs.does: One engine per actor; `concurrency` request slots; each request continues an earlier conversation or starts one.
runs.is: The values lmcache_local_disk's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): an engine with 64 request slots, 2,000 requests per slot to warm and 20,000 measured, 32 MiB chunks (128 KiB per token, an 8B model's), a context of 8,192, 40 conversations open per slot, 50 system prompts of a median 1,500 tokens, ShareGPT's turn lengths, and a pool that keeps nothing of 91% of returning conversations. Placeholders, not measured: no job stands behind them (the traces behind the abstract are the examples sharegpt-chat and agentx-odirect).

runs.does: Single builder: PQ training and compression, partition into shards, per-shard build, merge, disk layout, sample.
runs.is: Fitted to the 2026-10-02 trace of DiskANN build_disk_index (diskannpy 0.7.0): SIFT1M, degree 64, build list 100, 13 shards (build memory 0.25 GB), 20 threads. The compute is the traced run's under strace, not fitted: PQ training 59 s and the partition 91 s as traced, and 20 s per shard, the 407 s of the whole build less those two over its 13 shards (an upper bound: the merge, the layout, and the I/O are in it).

runs.does: Beam search over a sector-packed graph index: dependent rounds of `beam` concurrent 4 KiB reads per query.
runs.is: Fitted to the 2026-10-02 trace of DiskANN PQFlashIndex (diskannpy 0.7.0): SIFT1M, degree 64, search list 100, beam 4, 10,000 nodes cached by breadth-first levels, 1,000 queries from 1 thread. Its CPU is 0.5 ms a query, the user time measured on the traces (0.46 to 0.62 ms; DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.50), not fitted per case, and `near` the uncached trace's (the same index; a node cache skips those rounds).

runs.does: Beam search over a sector-packed graph index: dependent rounds of `beam` concurrent 4 KiB reads per query.
runs.is: Fitted to the 2026-10-02 trace of DiskANN PQFlashIndex (diskannpy 0.7.0): SIFT1M, degree 64, search list 100, beam 4, no node cache, 1,000 queries over 2 threads. Its CPU is 0.5 ms a query, the user time measured on the traces (0.46 to 0.62 ms; DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.50), not fitted per case.

runs.does: Per search call and OpenMP slice, prefetch threads touch every inverted list the slice's queries probe; lists chosen by popularity.
runs.is: Fitted to the 2026-10-01 trace of IndexIVFPQ.search over OnDiskInvertedLists: SIFT1M, IVF1024,PQ32, nprobe 64, 20 calls of one query, one OpenMP thread.
